detail.title: 4CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P Smart 1U 1SSD 1TB WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR5104C-I3(1T) 4CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P Smart 1U 1SSD 1TB WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • Preinstall 1TB SSD • 4-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 5M-N@20fps/1080p@25fps Encoding Capability • Max. 6-ch IP Video Input (Up to 6MP) • AI Functions: 1-ch QuickPick 2.0, 1-ch FR, 4-ch Perimeter Protection, 4-ch SMD, 4-ch AI Coding Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Perimeter Protection.Perimeter Performance AI by Recorder (Nu: Advanced Model: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel General Model: 4 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel

Face Detection.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 1 channel (up to 8 face images/s each channel)

Face Recognition.Face Database Capacity: Up to 10 face databases with 10,000 images.

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 4 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle , reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 6 channels of IPC access 2 IP channels by default + 4 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 32 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 32 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 32 Mbps *After IP extension is enabled, the AI Function (IVS, SMD, FACE) will be disabled.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: 5MP Mode: All channel 5MP@(1-6fps) 5M-N Mode: All channel 5M-N@(1–12fps);4M-N,1080p@(1–15fps); 1080N, 720p, 960H, D1,CIF@(1–25/30fps) Sub stream: D1, CIF@(1–15fps)
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/6
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: ONVIF; Panasonic; Sony; Axis; Arecont; Samsung

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 22.12(Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Record Mode: General; motion detection; intelligent; alarm; POS
Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback (face and motion detection)

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict) ;video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Intelligent Alarm: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log, preset; email

Ports.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
Ports.HDD Interface: 1 SSD:1TB(replaceable with 256 GB or 512 GB) Stores for 22 days under default settings.
